gaps: P0, P2, P3: nothing usable. P5: only 1945 aerials of the Škoda works and prison and 1950s orthophotos. P6: only night photos from the ISS.
notes: #1 is a smaller copy of the same Merian plate as #2. #2’s Commons date (1650) is generic; the plate is from Theatrum Europaeum vol. 1 (1635, per #1). A thin fold crease runs down the middle of the plate in both copies, but the picture is continuous. #9’s Commons date range is the artist’s lifetime; the card is postmarked or written 1905, and Spindler’s postcards date from around 1900. #3 is a detail crop (Litice Gate) of Merian’s 1650 Topographia view, not a general view. #4 is an illustration of the brewery inside an 1892 booklet; #6 and #8 are brewery postcards; #7 (Šafařík promenade, about 1900) is the alternative for P4.
